gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-montserrat: Montserrat leaves generous white space ahead of every curve, with wide e and a counters and a line that glides like wire. Fuzzy Bubbles' handwriting then feels like a friendly note.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-karma: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. But Karma, a serif with tight lowercase height and unsnagging modulation, holds the text steady where the heading plays.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-roundo: Loose, inked, a bit cheeky. Gabarito's open-cut terminals stand over Roundo, a sans whose n has arch and stem matching, and the contrast between expression and tidiness is the real draw.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-actor: Actor brings wide s curves that barely curl in, a sans-serif body with a clean modern face under Gabarito's marker-traced strokes. The mix of loose and crisp is the draw.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cardo: Cardo reads literary and dignified, its serif strokes shifting softly in thickness while counters stay linked to the outside. And Gabarito's marker-traced display strokes give that restraint a loose, expressive opening above.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-chakra-petch: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open so counters flow outward. Chakra Petch follows beneath, a sans with cupped round letters and a stroke that holds one width.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-znamenny-musical: Noto Znamenny Musical Notation is a clean, modern sans-serif whose terminals stop far from the stem. Yet Gabarito's curves and straights share one width, and that flat consistency is what ties the pair.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-special-gothic: Gabarito's stencil-cut flatness comes from strokes of single weight. Special Gothic, a plain sans with rounded, inviting letters, keeps a long read friendly and approachable.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sura: Gabarito has the plain line of a fixed-width stencil brush, with terminals cut open. But Sura, a text serif with slightly thinner hairlines, gives a long read a subtle pen-like modulation in its bowls.
